Question
========
After executing `data = numpy.loadtxt(fname='inflammation-01.csv', delimiter=',')`, what type of object is `data`?

Answerlist
-----------
* A Python list
* A dictionary
* A NumPy array
* A pandas dataframe
* A string
* A file handle

Solution
========
`numpy.loadtxt` loads data as a NumPy array.
